title: Points of Judgement: Election Withdrawal Interest Rate Where a Whole Life Insurance Deposit Is Drawn On Often
content:
**Rule.** On an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, the interest rate on accumulations withdrawn at a reduced paid-up election is lowered for a deposit drawn on often, judged by the accumulation withdrawals on the policy ledger dated within the last 12 calendar months: by **0.50 percentage point (0.005)** where there are two or more such withdrawals, by **0.25 percentage point (0.0025)** where there is exactly one, and not at all where there is none.

**Window.** The last 12 calendar months end today. A withdrawal dated later than the same day of the month twelve months ago is inside; one dated on that day or earlier is outside.

**Points of judgement (hypothetical, today June 15, 2026).**

1. Withdrawals dated March 2, 2026 and October 9, 2025: two inside the window — lowered by 0.005.
2. Withdrawals dated March 2, 2026 and June 15, 2025: the second is dated exactly twelve months ago and is outside — one withdrawal, lowered by 0.0025.
3. Withdrawals dated June 16, 2025 and May 1, 2026: both inside — lowered by 0.005.
4. No accumulation withdrawal since June 15, 2025: not lowered.

The reduction is subtracted from the rate in percentage points.
